slider.label: Sky HDR Scale
slider.name: sky_gamma
slider.tool_tip: Brightness of sky and haze relative to the scene; also sets how far auto-exposure can adjust. At 0.25 or below, auto-exposure is fixed at 1. (KS Reference)

slider.label: Exposure
slider.name: ks_exposure
slider.tool_tip: Overall scene exposure. No effect while Build > Options > No Post-processing is on and the Build floater is open.

check_box.label: Dynamic exposure
check_box.name: ks_dynamic_exposure
check_box.tool_tip: Adapts exposure to scene brightness. (KS Reference) No effect while Build > Options > No Post-processing is on and the Build floater is open.

text.name: ks_note_pinned
text.tool_tip: Auto-exposure is fixed at 1 because Sky HDR Scale is 0.25 or less.

combo_box.name: ks_tonemap
combo_box.tool_tip: No effect while Build > Options > No Post-processing is on and the Build floater is open.

slider.label: Tone mapping mix
slider.name: ks_tonemap_mix
slider.tool_tip: No effect while Build > Options > No Post-processing is on and the Build floater is open.

slider.label: Bright-scene level
slider.name: ks_exp_coef
slider.tool_tip: Scene luminance treated as fully bright; lower = darkens sooner.

slider.label: Settle accuracy
slider.name: ks_exp_error
slider.tool_tip: Fraction of the gap left after the settle time.

slider.label: Settle time (s)
slider.name: ks_exp_target
slider.tool_tip: Time to get within that fraction.

slider.label: Object weight
slider.name: ks_exp_objects
slider.tool_tip: Weight of scene objects vs sky in metering.

check_box.label: Use sky exposure range
check_box.name: ks_exp_sky_range
check_box.tool_tip: Uses the sky's own exposure range (HDR offset plus or minus min/max) instead of Sky HDR Scale.
